verdict: NOT primarily MVCC bloat. ~83% of live rows are superseded proposal versions created because evidence_digest includes discovery_run_id, so every recurring Yuyu discovery run re-versions every unchanged pending listing (INSERT new + UPDATE old superseded_at). Heap free/dead share is ~13%.

row_width_bytes.note: evidence_summary_json is SQLAlchemy JSON -> postgres json (text), ~900 B inline, uncompressed (below TOAST threshold), toast empty

MEASURED.note_ins_vs_live: n_tup_ins exceeds live by ~1.1k with n_tup_del=0: aborted/rolled-back inserts (dead, reclaimed by vacuum)

ESTIMATE.steady_state_basis: 2,164 created on each of 2026-10-08 and 10-09 (bursts ~13:00Z 1,247 and ~01-04Z ~915)
ESTIMATE.dead_tuple_ceiling: autovacuum triggers at 50+0.2*live ~= 5,420 dead (~7 MB) -> explains 456..4,655 swings; dead space is reused, not the growth driver

hot_zero_explanation: supersede UPDATE sets superseded_at, which is in the predicate of partial unique index uq_mapping_proposal_groups_current_listing -> never HOT-eligible (PG treats predicate columns as indexed)
review/decision updates change review_status / resulting_source_card_mapping_id (both indexed) -> not HOT
fillfactor 100 with ~1.25 KB rows (~6/page) leaves no room on page even when HOT would be allowed

update_writers.digest_input: services/api/app/services/source_mapping_proposals.py:171-191 _candidate_payload includes 'discovery_run_id' (174 yuyutei, 190 snkrdunk); _make_plan:248 evidence_digest=_digest(evidence); physical-proof path :612
update_writers.caller: services/api/app/services/discovery_proposal_refresh.py (added 4ca9ae7, 2026-10-04) called from services/yuyutei_collector/yuyutei_collector/due_discovery.py:79-81 on every discovery claim

recommendations.change: Exclude volatile 'discovery_run_id' from the digest input (e.g. _digest({k:v for k,v in evidence.items() if k!='discovery_run_id'}) in _make_plan and the physical-proof replace at :612). Keep run-derived outcome (stale/superseded status) covered: persist_proposals already raises if status differs for equal digest, so either add resolution_status into the digest payload or treat status change as new evidence.
recommendations.effect: new versions/day ~2,164 -> ~70 (material changes only); growth ~5.3 -> ~0.2 MB/day; n_tup_upd falls proportionally
recommendations.risk: One-time re-version of ~4.7k current rows (~11 MB incl. alternatives) when the digest formula changes, unless gated by a RESOLVER_VERSION bump scheduled once; tests in services/api/tests/test_source_mapping_proposals.py assert digest/reuse semantics. Stored evidence_summary_json keeps the first run id (lineage of latest run lost unless stored elsewhere, e.g. update only on material change).

recommendations.class: AMBER data cleanup (DELETE, ROW EXCLUSIVE lock, no rewrite)
recommendations.change: After R1, prune superseded pending rows never reviewed (cascade to alternatives) or keep only last N per listing.
recommendations.effect: removes ~22k rows / ~35 MB groups + ~11 MB alternatives as reusable free space (not returned to OS)
recommendations.risk: loses proposal history/audit; check decision audit dependencies; generates WAL ~ size of deleted data; needs explicit approval

recommendations.lock: SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE (blocks only other VACUUM/ANALYZE/DDL; not reads/writes), instant
recommendations.effect: dead ceiling ~5.4k -> ~1.8k tuples (~4 MB less transient)
recommendations.risk: low; marginal value once R1 lands

recommendations.why: supersede updates can never be HOT (partial-index predicate column); would only inflate heap; also requires rewrite to apply to existing pages

recommendations.class: AMBER table rewrite (VACUUM FULL / CLUSTER / pg_repack)
recommendations.lock: VACUUM FULL: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE for whole run (est. 2-10 s for ~50 MB + 11 indexes on Railway disk; up to ~30 s under IO contention). Blocks discovery refresh (due_discovery -> persist_proposals), admin proposal review API, and any API read of proposals; collectors' price paths unaffected unless they touch proposals. pg_repack not installed (pg_extension shows only plpgsql) -> would need CREATE EXTENSION (forbidden here).
recommendations.effect: only worth it after R1+R2; would return ~40 MB to OS
recommendations.note: plain VACUUM only truncates trailing empty pages (brief ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on truncate); otherwise space becomes reusable in-table, not returned to OS

queries.now: select now() at time zone 'utc' as observed_at, current_setting('server_version') as server_version
queries.sizes:
select c.relname, pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) total, pg_relation_size(c.oid) heap,
   coalesce(pg_total_relation_size(c.reltoastrelid),0) toast, pg_indexes_size(c.oid) idx, c.reloptions, c.relpages, c.reltuples,
   s.n_live_tup,s.n_dead_tup,s.n_tup_ins,s.n_tup_upd,s.n_tup_hot_upd,s.n_tup_del,s.n_mod_since_analyze,
   s.last_vacuum,s.last_autovacuum,s.last_analyze,s.last_autoanalyze,s.vacuum_count,s.autovacuum_count,s.autoanalyze_count
   from pg_class c join pg_stat_user_tables s on s.relid=c.oid
   where c.relname in ('source_mapping_proposal_groups','source_mapping_proposal_alternatives')
queries.indexes:
select indexrelname, pg_relation_size(indexrelid) bytes, idx_scan, pg_get_indexdef(indexrelid) def
   from pg_stat_user_indexes where relname='source_mapping_proposal_groups' order by 2 desc
queries.autovacuum_settings:
select name, setting, unit from pg_settings where name like 'autovacuum%'
   or name in ('vacuum_cost_limit','vacuum_cost_delay','block_size')
queries.row_width:
select count(*) n, count(*) filter (where superseded_at is null) current_rows,
   count(*) filter (where superseded_at is not null) superseded_rows,
   avg(pg_column_size(t.*))::int avg_row_bytes, sum(pg_column_size(t.*)) sum_row_bytes, max(pg_column_size(t.*)) max_row_bytes,
   avg(pg_column_size(evidence_summary_json))::int avg_evidence_bytes, sum(pg_column_size(evidence_summary_json)) sum_evidence_bytes,
   avg(pg_column_size(resolution_reasons_json))::int avg_reasons_bytes, avg(pg_column_size(source_url))::int avg_url_bytes
   from source_mapping_proposal_groups t
queries.alternatives_width:
select count(*) alts, count(*) filter (where g.superseded_at is not null) alts_of_superseded,
   avg(pg_column_size(a.*))::int avg_alt_bytes from source_mapping_proposal_alternatives a join source_mapping_proposal_groups g on g.id=a.proposal_group_id
queries.created_per_day: select date_trunc('day',created_at) d, count(*) n from source_mapping_proposal_groups group by 1 order by 1
queries.superseded_per_day: select date_trunc('day',superseded_at) d, count(*) n from source_mapping_proposal_groups where superseded_at is not null group by 1 order by 1
queries.created_per_hour_48h: select date_trunc('hour',created_at) h, count(*) n from source_mapping_proposal_groups where created_at > now()-interval '48 hours' group by 1 order by 1
queries.versions_per_listing:
select n versions, count(*) listings from (select source_id, canonical_source_listing_identity, count(*) n
   from source_mapping_proposal_groups group by 1,2) x group by n order by n
queries.resolver_versions: select resolver_version, count(*) n, min(created_at), max(created_at) from source_mapping_proposal_groups group by 1 order by 3
queries.new_since_1009: select count(*) n from source_mapping_proposal_groups where created_at>='2026-10-09'
queries.new_since_1009_material_change:
select count(*) n from (select g.id from source_mapping_proposal_groups g join source_mapping_proposal_groups p
   on p.source_id=g.source_id and p.canonical_source_listing_identity=g.canonical_source_listing_identity
   and p.superseded_at between g.created_at and g.created_at+interval '1 minute'
   where g.created_at>='2026-10-09' and ((p.evidence_summary_json::jsonb - 'discovery_run_id')
   is distinct from (g.evidence_summary_json::jsonb - 'discovery_run_id')
   or p.resolution_status<>g.resolution_status or p.resolver_version<>g.resolver_version)) x
queries.superseded_identical_to_current_minus_ru:
select count(*) n from source_mapping_proposal_groups g where superseded_at is not null
   and review_status='pending' and exists (select 1 from source_mapping_proposal_groups c where c.source_id=g.source_id
   and c.canonical_source_listing_identity=g.canonical_source_listing_identity and c.superseded_at is null
   and c.resolver_version=g.resolver_version and c.resolution_status=g.resolution_status
   and (c.evidence_summary_json::jsonb - 'discovery_run_id')=(g.evidence_summary_json::jsonb - 'discovery_run_id'))
queries.referencing_fks: select conrelid::regclass::text t, conname, confdeltype from pg_constraint where confrelid='source_mapping_proposal_groups'::regclass
